systems.system: Portail des données ouvertes de la Mauritanie

note: The strategy designs a national open data portal (Priority 2.2) and recommends one; it states no portal publishing data, so no fact.
The purchase plan lists the portal as a planned procurement (consultant selection March-April 2026), not a live portal, so no fact.
The launched portal gives access to legal texts (Journal Officiel), not datasets or tables for download, so no fact for class open.

The decree obliges extractive-sector reporting entities to publish in open data format under a free licence but states no data actually published; a law with no data said to be published gives no fact.
The data protection authority's strategic plan passages mention no published open data or portal; no fact.

facts.fact: The EITI Board decision of 12 November 2024 states that Mauritania EITI, the government-backed multi-stakeholder body set up by Decree 2018-135, makes extractive revenue, production and export data available on its Data Warehouse portal with data sets downloadable in CSV; the date is the decision's, as it describes the portal running.
The Board decision reports that Mauritania EITI's outcomes template cites three 2023 news articles (Agence Ecofin, taqas.net, Mines actu), two of which make use of EITI data.

note: No open licence stated (Board recommends stating the reuse licence); no count of publishing bodies.
Only passage is a footnote citing a Gambia disability data portal; nothing on open data publication in Mauritania.
